reference_resolution.rule: locale must resolve to an actual CLDR locale identifier — no orphan references (issue-515 invariant 2).

recomputation.rule: pattern_value is recomputed by re-validating it against the locale's current LDML pattern grammar, never a standalone asserted field.
recomputation.checked_by: TBD (follow-up — issue-521 out-of-scope note: per-role recomputation enforcement is a follow-up once evidence from real usage shows which roles need it)

use_when.board_condition: a new locale or translated string lands on the branch AND no localization record exists yet for that locale
